entities.summary: Paul Dakeyo (b. 1948, Bafoussam) was a military leader or commander of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Bafoussam and Cameroon. Known in the fields of cameroon, merchants & economists, africa.
